architecture: v4 (Tillford County's single-family reappraisal offer: whether the Board of Commissioners accepts its appraisal vendor's offer of a county-wide single-family reappraisal before it lapses on 30 October 2026, read on the State Tax Commission's ratio study standard for the certified 2026 roll, whose assessor reviewed every parcel sold in 2025 and moved its value toward its price while every other parcel was trended by its neighbourhood's factor)
slot_note: re-drawn 2026-10-25 at architecture 4 in a fresh world at the author's direction (no number in the lane is retired); the world, decision and quantity are new, the pitfall re-found from the data: a ratio study's sales sample the roll only if the sold parcels were valued like the unsold ones
niche: a county board's decision to accept a vendor's offer of a county-wide single-family reappraisal, judged on the state ratio study of a roll whose assessor revalued the parcels sold in the study year toward their own sale prices while trending every other parcel by its neighbourhood's factor
answer: accept the vendor's offer of the county-wide single-family reappraisal: the certified 2026 single-family roll fails Rule 18-7 on both tests (median assessment ratio 0.87, COD 18)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every rule and field correctly runs the State's ratio study on the 2025 arm's-length single-family sales, each price carried to 1 January 2026 by the county index and set against the parcel's certified 2026 value, finds a median of 0.95 and a COD of 8, and files that the roll meets the standard and the county lets its vendor's reappraisal offer lapse, though the assessor reset the sold parcels' values toward their prices (up a median 14.9 per cent against 3.4 for the unsold parcels) so the sales no longer sample the roll, and the sold parcels' 2025 values carried forward by their neighbourhoods' factors, with the reset parcels at their 6.7 per cent share, put the roll at 0.87 and 18, failing both tests.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the median and coefficient of dispersion of every single-family parcel's 2026 assessment ratio, a measurement-error distribution known only on the sold parcels, and the field's own analysis is the ratio study with its test of whether the sales sample the roll (sold against unsold parcels' value changes, the sales-chasing screen of mass appraisal) and the sold parcels' prior values carried forward as the out-of-sample measure; replacing that estimate with the sales' own statistics flips the call, and in another field's nouns no recorded value is reset from the very price that measures it.
layer1: the 2025 roll exported by the county's retired appraisal system as a workbook with dashed parcel numbers and neighbourhood names, the 2026 roll from its replacement as CSV with undashed numbers and neighbourhood codes
parcels split or combined between the two rolls, the new numbers traced in the assessor's parcel change log
the recorder's sales extract with non-market transfers coded U, deeds conveying more than one parcel and re-recorded corrective deeds
building permits picked up in the 2026 values, some on parcels sold before the work was finaled
Board of Review reductions of 2025 values carried into the 2026 base, and the assessor's data corrections on a few per cent of parcels
the county price index published monthly to one decimal on a January 2025 base
stakeholder_role: policy analyst in the Tillford County Administrator's office (Budget and Policy Analysis), advising the Board of Commissioners on its appraisal vendor's reappraisal offer

spine.entity: one parcel on the certified 2026 assessment roll with its assessed land, improvement and total values
spine.row_meaning: the assessor's certified 2026 value of one parcel as at 1 January 2026
spine.source_dataset: constructed (seeded generator; the county, its state, offices and people are fictional)

world.geography: United States (Tillford County and its state are fictional)
world.org_type: county government (the County Administrator's office for the Board of Commissioners; the elected County Assessor certifies the roll)

driver: The decisive quantity is the level and spread over a whole population of a ratio of each unit's recorded value to its true value, where the true value is observed only for units an event sampled and the keeper of the record reset the sampled units' recorded values from those very observations, so the sample's ratios sit tighter and nearer the target than the population's; only each sampled unit's recorded value from before the event, carried forward at the change the unsampled units received, mixed with the reset units at their share of the population, measures it.
driver_concrete: The 2026 roll's median assessment ratio and COD over every single-family parcel, evidenced by the 2025 arm's-length sales: the assessor reviewed each sold parcel and moved its 2026 value toward its price while trending every other parcel by its neighbourhood's factor, so each sold parcel's 2025 value times its neighbourhood's factor (the unsold parcels' median change), over its indexed price, stands for the 93.3 per cent of the roll that did not sell, the sold parcels' own ratios for the rest.
stump: A competent analyst runs the State's ratio study on the 2025 arm's-length sales against the certified 2026 values (median 0.95, COD 8) and files that the roll meets the standard and the county lets its vendor's reappraisal offer lapse; the sold parcels' values were reset toward their prices (up 14.9 per cent at the median against 3.4 for the unsold parcels), so only their 2025 values carried forward by the neighbourhood factors, mixed with the reset parcels at their share of the roll, show it failing both tests (median 0.87, COD 18).

differentiation.task104: task104 replays a self-adapting scorer whose flags withheld observations from its own reference, so its log describes only the setting it ran at; here no setting is replayed: the roll's values for the sold parcels were reset from the very prices that measure them, and the roll's accuracy is estimated out of sample from those parcels' values before the review.
differentiation.task134: task134 v1 estimates an event probability under competing exits and follow-up cut short; nothing here is a time to an event: the quantity is the level and dispersion of a ratio distribution, and the sample's defect is that its units' recorded values were reset from the measurement, not that they are followed short.
differentiation.task177: task177 v1 separates imposed from chosen experiences in a conversion rate learned from the record; nothing here converts: the sold parcels' ratios are the in-sample accuracy of a valuation the sale itself reset, and the remedy is each parcel's prior value carried forward, not a separate rate.
differentiation.task463: task463 builds a price index's change over a span by avoiding chained weights through sale periods; no index is built here: the county index is filed and only carries prices to the assessment date, and the decisive move is which values stand for the parcels that did not sell.
differentiation.task480: task480 v1 reads an instrument's under-recording from units of the same kind whose instrument was not replaced; here the instrument (the roll) is not replaced but refitted to the sampled units, and its error over the whole population comes from the sampled units' own values before the refit.
differentiation.task501: task501 sets whether a chain process can sustain itself by a mixing matrix's dominant eigenvalue; nothing here is a matrix or a threshold of spread: the median and dispersion of a ratio distribution are estimated for a roll whose sample was reset.
differentiation.task70: task70 v2 constructs a per-record date with a class-conditional cut that a filed clause bars; nothing here is a date or a filed bar: the sold parcels' values were reset by the assessor's review, which no clause states and no field marks.
differentiation.task275: task275 raises an observer scheme's discards where being observed changes the fishing itself, so the outcome moves and the unobserved trips are rebuilt from a catch rate the observation did not touch; here the outcome (each parcel's market value) is untouched by the sale and it is the measuring record that was refitted to the sampled units, so the population is measured from the record as it stood before the refit, carried forward, and mixed with the refitted units at their share.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how consistently a total over several scored parts will rank units once each part is scored by one scorer drawn from a pool and different units meet different scorers, estimated from a round in which the same two scorers scored every unit on each part; in that round a scorer's own level was shared by every unit and so never moved a ranking, so the agreement between parts, each scorer's marks taken alone and a decomposition that keeps the scorers shared all leave it out, while under the new arrangement it adds to every unit's error, so the number of parts has to come from the round's sources of variance recombined with the scorers' levels counted as error.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Callowfield University's 2027 final-year OSCE, single-examined in three parallel circuits once Fennabeg Clinical School's cohort joins: the number of stations its total marks need for the school's reliability standard of 0.80, projected from the 2026 sitting's dual-examined marks with each station's examiner stringency counted as error)
lineage.stump: A competent solver computes the 2026 sitting's reliability on single-examiner marks (alpha across the stations, or a generalizability study with the examiners crossed with the candidates) and steps it to more stations by Spearman-Brown, filing the current 12 stations as enough; the step that lands it there is reading each examiner's leniency as 2026 showed it, a shift every candidate at that station shared, when in 2027's parallel circuits different candidates meet different examiners and the leniency spread between examiners becomes error in every candidate's total.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 (Gate F): the cold reader split the 2026 marks into candidates by examiners within stations and counted the stringency as error for one examiner a station, committing the golden call and every ask figure; the judge DETERMINISTIC with Gates G and H passing

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how consistently a total over parts will rank units when the specification fixes how many parts come from each content area every time, so each unit's strength in an area recurs in every form and belongs to the true score; estimated from a round whose parts were drawn the same way, the analysis that treats the parts as drawn from one undivided pool counts that strength as error and overstates the number of parts a standard needs.
lineage.architecture: v2 (Callowfield University's 2027 final OSCE, single-examined in three parallel circuits on a blueprint that draws the same number of stations from each of four domains every year: the number of stations for the school's 0.80 reliability standard, from the 2026 marks' variance components with each candidate's domain-specific strength counted as true score under the fixed blueprint and the examiner's stringency as error)
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits the 2026 marks' variance components with the stations and examiners random from one bank, counts the examiner's stringency as error for one examiner a station and files 16 stations; the step that lands it there is counting the candidate-by-domain variance as error, when the blueprint draws the same number of stations from each domain every year, so a candidate's domain strengths recur in every form and belong to what the total mark measures.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 round 3 (Gate F): of six scored readers five filed 16 stations by the pooled decision study and the sixth stratified the 2026 marks by the blueprint's domains under policy 4.2 and landed the call (13) and every reliability; the judge's pass 3 found Ask B's namesake device unfair, repaired before round 3

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the expected excess wait of units arriving at random at a point served by interleaved streams of departures, where units bound for some destinations can take any stream and units bound for others only one, so each unit's wait is worked over the departures serving its own destination, read from a second file at the unit's grain; the measure over all departures overstates the units tied to one stream wherever the streams bunch with each other, and the measure over the stream each unit happened to take understates the units that could take any.
lineage.stump: A competent solver works each route's excess wait from all of its departures at the corridor timing points, weights it by corridor boardings and gives the teams to routes 3, 7, 14 and 31 (or, splitting by the branch of the bus each rider boarded, drops route 7 for route 9); the step that lands it there is taking the route, or the boarded bus, as each rider's service when a rider bound for a branch can take only that branch's buses and one bound for the corridor either.
lineage.architecture: v3 (Pellbrook Metro's 2027 headway management programme: which four of the eight frequent bus routes get the operator's supervisor teams, ranked on the excess wait per weekday-peak boarding on each route's frequent corridor in the August census fortnight, each rider's wait measured against the buses that serve the stop they tag off at)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4 on the judge's SEND_BACK: the departures that end a rider's wait are the outcome's definition, and the industry's route-level excess wait is a licensed literal reading of a standard that says 'the departures', so filing the set is rule application; the two scored readers missed the call
